newsitem.title: FRANCE: Guterres - Portugal can join EMU without Spain, Italy.
newsitem.headline: Guterres - Portugal can join EMU without Spain, Italy.

text.p: Portugal's Prime Minister Antonio Guterres said on Monday any country meeting criteria for a single currency should be allowed to join, Financial daily Les Echos reported.

In a newspaper interview published on Monday, he said it would be a violation of the Maastricht treaty to exclude Portugal from the launch of a single currency simply because it is a southern European country.
Guterres rejected the application of the name "Club Med" given to southern nations and said any nation fulfilling the requirements of the treaty should be allowed to join EMU.
"The European Union is not a travel agency. It is a political institution. There is no 'Club Med,'" he told financial daily Les Echos.

"Each country is a sovereign nation that subscribes to a treaty. Each country has the right to be judged on its merits," he said, insisting that Portugal could join EMU even if Spain and Italy could not meet the tough financial criteria needed to do so.

"In any case that has always been the position of (German Chancellor Helmut) Kohl. All other options would be unacceptable. It would be a judicial violation of the treaty, a violation of the sovereignty of states and a moral violation of the will to build a united Europe."
